name: Shirahana no Ori ~Hiiro no Kakera 4~
source:
Tamayori hime is the priestess who's in charge of sealing the sword that might bring the end of the world. To do this, she bears her loneliness and everybody's sin without complaint. However, everything changes when she meets a god in the middle of a snowy night. Gentouka has the power to grant immortality, and has been chased around by the government officials. And following his lead, more trouble and complications enter the life of the priestess.

The 4th installment brings gamers into the glamorous and decadent Heian period in this bittersweet love story. 

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/Shirahana_no_Ori_Hiiro_no_Kakera_4_Regular_Edition/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-53zn.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
玉依公主是负责封印那把可能带来世界末日之剑的巫女。为此，她毫无怨言地承受着孤独和所有人的罪孽。然而，在一个雪夜中遇到一位神明后，一切都改变了。幻灯花拥有赋予永生的力量，一直被政府官员追捕。在他的引领下，更多的麻烦和纠葛涌入了巫女的生活。第四部将玩家带入华丽而颓废的平安时代，展开这段苦甜参半的恋爱故事。

[来自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/Shirahana_no_Ori_Hiiro_no_Kakera_4_Regular_Edition/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-53zn.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
